vision.title: Our Vision
paragraphs: Vedaansh is a community platform rooted in Vedic culture — bringing together authentic Jyotish (Vedic astrology), scripture-aligned knowledge, and practical tools for seekers, students, and practitioners.

We believe the wisdom of the rishis should be accessible without losing depth: accurate chart work, Panchang timing, Prashna clarity, and classical references — presented with care, dignity, and reverence for tradition.

Whether you are learning your first kundali, planning life events with muhurta, or serving clients as a consultant, Vedaansh is built to support a living Vedic community — learning together, growing together, and aligning daily life with cosmic rhythm.

pillars.title: Vedic Astrology
pillars.text: Deep kundali, varga, dasha, and interpretation — Swiss Ephemeris precision with Lahiri ayanamsha.

pillars.title: Scripture & Tradition
pillars.text: Classical Jyotish logic, nakshatra wisdom, and time-honoured methods — not surface-level horoscopes.

pillars.title: Culture & Community
pillars.text: A shared space for seekers, families, and guides — Panchang, Prashna, and consultation-ready workflows.

creator.name: Abhishek Kumar
creator.subtitle: Creator of Vedaansh
paragraphs: Abhishek Kumar is a software engineer who built Vedaansh to bring rigorous Vedic astrology tools to everyone — with the same seriousness he brings to code: clarity, accuracy, and respect for the subject.

As a devoted student of Sameer Bhatnagar ji, his work on this platform is directly inspired by his Guru's teachings on Jyotish, meditation, and the spiritual path. Every feature is an offering toward making sacred knowledge more reachable — without diluting it.

thanks.text: Special thanks to Sameer Bhatnagar sir — the app's functionalities are inspired by his teachings and wisdom.

faq.a: Vedaansh is a free Vedic astrology platform offering birth charts (Kundali), Dasha, 41 varga charts, Panchang, Nakshatra analysis, and Muhurta tools with Swiss Ephemeris precision.
Core chart calculation, Panchang, and many Jyotish tools are free. Optional paid plans add saved charts, exports, and advanced features.
Vedaansh uses Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsha by default, with Swiss Ephemeris for arc-second accurate planetary positions.
